Anna Keller studied the rivers of the north for most of her career.
Chidi Okafor published his memoir about exile with a London press.
Peter Walsh argued that grain markets in Ireland were poorly regulated.
Hiroshi Tanaka spent years writing about rice and the Japanese state.
Elena Garcia photographed coastal birds along the Spanish shore.
In 2015 a team measured soil carbon in several grasslands.
Jan Novak lived in Prague during the spring of 1968.
